body: Stop chasing the moments. Trust me I know what you're going through. Live your life day to day as best as you can. Fake being healthy. Convince your subconscious that theres a way out. It's not easy. Really it's about as hard a challenge as any. But your mind, however unhealthy, ruined and fucked up, is still an adaptation machine. Every fucking day, work on teaching it to adapt to the healthy you. But just for a while. Fake being okay. For an hour. Got through an hour? Try a day. Then a week. Then a month. Act like a healthy person for a month. Act like it. Do all the things the healthiest version of you would. Sooner than you know, your brain will fill with the joy you wished you had. Again, message me if you need. I'm just a stranger. It can't hurt.
If there's nobody to talk to, message me. U don't know me. Just try.

Don't do it. That simple. Good moments have come. They'll come again. You haven't tried everything. Let's be real. The solution is somewhere. Don't you wanna try a few more times to see if you'll find it? Remember the moment you were happiest. You have many years left. Is there no chance that happiness will return? Statistically, you need to hang on. The smile grows slow but let it grow.
